home.countValue: Just the number; the code uses it to find the count inside counted text. Copy exactly as is: {count}
home.noPlan: Overview page, shown when the plan has no root file. {file} is the file name 'plan.md' and {command} is the CLI command 'constellation init' — both stay as they are. Keep the backticks around {command}.
home.health.lastSynced: Small grey status line in the overview's health strip. {when} is a relative time already in your language ('4m ago', 'just now'). Lowercase sentence fragment; parts are joined with ' · '.
home.health.noSyncPoint: Health strip status line when the plan was never stamped with a sync point (a git commit marking 'the plan was true here'). Lowercase fragment.
home.health.sinceMarker: Health strip, after 'last synced …'. {commits} is home.health.codeCommits and {changes} is home.health.planChanges, both already counted ('3 code commits'). 'since' = since the sync point.
home.health.codeCommits: Count of git commits that changed code since the sync point. Inserted into home.health.sinceMarker.
home.health.planChanges: Count of plan (card) changes since the sync point. Inserted into home.health.sinceMarker.
home.health.planDirty: Health strip fragment: the plan folder has edits not yet committed to git.
home.health.setSyncPoint: Small button in the health strip: record the current git commit as the plan's sync point (first time).
home.health.updateSyncPoint: Small button in the health strip: move the existing sync point to the current git commit.
home.health.chip.cards: Tiny uppercase label next to a number in the health strip ('42 CARDS'). Shown for any count; use a plural/collective form. Keep very short.
home.health.chip.connections: Tiny uppercase label next to the number of links between cards ('97 CONNECTIONS'). Shown for any count. Keep very short.
home.health.chip.errors: Health strip chip: a lint error count ('2 ERRORS'). The number is shown big and bold before the remaining words, which become a tiny uppercase label — keep them short.
home.health.chip.warnings: Health strip chip: a lint warning count. The number is shown big and bold before the remaining words, which become a tiny uppercase label.
home.health.chip.clean: Shown in the number slot (bold) when there are no lint errors, above/next to the label 'integrity'. One short word.
home.health.chip.integrity: Tiny uppercase label under 'clean': the plan's structural integrity (no broken links). One short word.
home.health.chip.drifted: Tiny uppercase label next to the number of cards whose code changed since they were verified.
home.health.chip.untracked: Tiny uppercase label next to the number of cards with no drift baseline yet.
home.health.chip.noDrift: Shown in the number slot (bold) when no card's code has drifted, next to the label 'code'. Very short.
home.health.chip.code: Tiny uppercase label after 'no drift' — reads 'no drift · code'. The source code, not a code number.
home.releases.title: Panel heading on the overview, small uppercase.
home.releases.latestTag: {tag} is the newest git tag, e.g. 'v1.2.0'. Means: this version has been tagged in git.
home.releases.packageVersion: {version} is the version string from {file} (always 'package.json', keep as is).
home.releases.noTags: Releases panel: the repo has no git tags and no package version.
home.releases.empty: Empty state of the Releases panel. RELEASE and FEATURE are card type names — keep them in capitals. {releaseField} and {changeField} are the field names 'release:' and 'change:', shown as code.
home.releases.tagged: Tiny uppercase pill on a release row: this version has a matching git tag.
home.releases.breakingCount: Tiny uppercase pill / summary piece: number of breaking changes in a release ('2 breaking'). Adjective used as a noun; keep short.
home.releases.noFeatures: Expanded release with no FEATURE cards pointing at it. FEATURE is a card type name — keep in capitals.
home.releases.open: Link at the bottom of an expanded release. {handle} is a card ID like RELEASE-V1-2-0. Keep the arrow.
home.releases.summary.shipped: Right-aligned grey summary on a release row with no features, when the release has shipped.
home.releases.summary.noFeatures: Right-aligned grey summary on a release row that has no features yet.
home.releases.summary.features: Right-aligned grey summary on a shipped release: how many features it contained.
home.releases.summary.progress: Right-aligned grey summary on a release in progress. {shipped} is how many are done, {count} the total.
home.releases.group.breaking: Small uppercase group heading in a release: breaking changes.
home.releases.group.feature: Small uppercase group heading in a release: new features.
home.releases.group.fix: Small uppercase group heading in a release: bug fixes.
home.releases.group.chore: Small uppercase group heading in a release: maintenance/housekeeping work.
home.activity.title: Panel heading on the overview, small uppercase: recent git commits.
home.activity.kind.plan: Tiny uppercase tag on a commit row (fixed width, about 5 characters): the commit changed plan cards.
home.activity.kind.code: Tiny uppercase tag on a commit row (fixed width, about 5 characters): the commit changed source code.
home.activity.syncTag: Tiny uppercase pill on the commit that is the plan's sync point.
home.activity.moreCards: After two card IDs on a commit row: how many more cards the commit touched ('+3').
home.drift.title: Panel heading on the overview, small uppercase: cards whose bound code changed.
home.drift.nothingTracked: Drift panel verdict when no card has a baseline to compare against yet.
home.drift.claimsHold: Drift panel verdict (green): every tracked card still matches its code. A 'claim' is a card describing code.
home.drift.claimsDrifted: Drift panel verdict (amber). {drifted} cards out of {count} tracked cards have code that changed.
home.drift.filesChanged: On a drifted card's row: how many bound files changed. Followed by ' · ' and one of home.drift.baseline.*.
home.drift.baseline.verified: On a drifted card's row: changed since the card was last verified against the code.
home.drift.baseline.cardCommit: On a drifted card's row: changed since the card file's last git commit.
home.drift.baseline.syncMarker: On a drifted card's row: changed since the plan's sync point.
home.drift.baseline.argument: On a drifted card's row: changed since an explicitly given base commit.
home.drift.baseline.fallback: On a drifted card's row: changed since its (unspecified) baseline.
home.drift.overflow: Below the capped list of drifted cards: how many more are not listed.
home.drift.untracked: Footnote in the drift panel. {count} is shown bold; {hint} is home.drift.untrackedHint.
home.drift.untrackedHint: Inserted at the end of home.drift.untracked. 'them' = the cards with no baseline. {tool} is the tool name 'set_verified' — keep as is.
home.notes.title: Panel heading on the overview, small uppercase: recent notes left on cards.
home.notes.kind.decision: Kind of a note on a card, shown in a narrow column (about 8 characters, truncates). A decision that was made.
home.notes.kind.gotcha: Kind of a note on a card, shown in a narrow column. A pitfall / trap to watch out for.
home.notes.kind.state: Kind of a note on a card, shown in a narrow column. The current state of the work.
home.notes.kind.deviation: Kind of a note on a card, shown in a narrow column. Where the code departs from the plan.
home.notes.kind.verified: Kind of a note on a card, shown in a narrow column. A record that the card was checked against the code.
home.notes.empty: Empty state of the Notes panel. {tool} is the tool name 'append_note', shown as code — keep as is.
home.repos.title: Section heading on the overview, small uppercase: other repositories linked to this plan.
home.repos.hint: Small grey footnote under the connected repos list. 'switcher' = the workspace menu at the top of the sidebar.
home.repos.current: Right side of a connected-repo row: this row is the workspace you are viewing now.
home.repos.cardCount: Right side of a connected-repo row: how many cards that repo's plan has.
home.repos.notServed: Right side of a connected-repo row: this viewer cannot open that repo's plan.
